decisions.reason: The message uses existing content reuse as the basis for the SEO strategy but does not change which legacy materials are reused or their reuse purpose.
Preserving SEO elements and planning migration does not change the selected design reference, layout, structure, or navigation requirements.
The SEO migration strategy does not alter the Shatter House brand name or Ridgehaven brand identity.
The master domain remains unchanged, while linking or retaining the Harbor Valley domain is presented only as conditional on a later client decision.
The conditional possibility of linking the Harbor Valley site does not necessarily change the existing requirement for the master site to show and route users to locations.
The SEO-preservation and migration plan does not change support for future franchise locations or the consistent location-template strategy.
The migration strategy does not change the requirement that each location track revenue and sales separately.
The migration strategy does not change separate booking management for each location.
